summary: community.hashi_vault now has a tighter version range for the requests package needed by hvac in some cases, because of backported security changes in ansible-core.
questions: Why is the requests version restricted for community.hashi_vault?
Is community.hashi_vault affected by requests version changes?

answer_card.title: hashi_vault requests restriction
answer_card.answer_md: For some use cases community.hashi_vault now restricts the `requests` version (used by `hvac`) more tightly, because of breaking security changes backported in ansible-core.
